records.source: Hey, I was wondering what you were up to!$0
records.translation: Hoy, iniisip ko kung ano ang ginagawa mo!$0

records.source: I wore my best tie for the occasion.$4
records.translation: Isinuot ko ang pinakamaganda kong kurbata para sa okasyong ito.$4

records.source: Hey, I'm feeling pretty good about today. We'll do great during the ceremony... just follow my lead.$0
records.translation: Hoy, maganda ang kutob ko sa araw na ito. Magiging mahusay tayo sa seremonya... sundan mo lang ako.$0

records.source: Whoa, you look really great today.$0
records.translation: Whoa, napakaganda mo ngayon.$0

records.source: You're the only reason I came all the way out here...$1
records.translation: Ikaw lang ang dahilan kung bakit nagpakalayo-layo ako rito...$1

records.source: May I have this dance?$4
records.translation: Maaari ba kitang makasayaw?$4

records.source: *burp* I might've eaten too much to dance... sorry.$0
records.translation: *dighay* Baka naparami ang kinain ko para makasayaw... pasensiya na.$0

records.source: They should make the seniors dance this year. I bet they'd love it!
records.translation: Dapat pasayawin nila ang matatanda ngayong taon. Tiyak akong magugustuhan nila iyon!

records.source: Is that the smell of flowers? Or is it Caroline's perfume?$0
records.translation: Amoy ng mga bulaklak ba iyon? O pabango ni Caroline?$0

records.source: Gatherings like this give a sense of identity to our community.#$b#Or as my wife says... 'it makes the town lively'!
records.translation: Nagbibigay ng pagkakakilanlan sa ating komunidad ang mga pagtitipong tulad nito.#$b#O gaya ng sabi ng asawa ko... 'pinasisigla nito ang bayan'!

records.source: It can be a little nerve-racking to ask someone to dance with you.$0
records.translation: Medyo nakakakabang yayain ang isang taong sumayaw kasama mo.$0

records.source: I didn't come here by choice.$0
records.translation: Hindi ko piniling pumunta rito.$0

records.source: Did you have a successful salmonberry harvest?$0#$b#I picked enough to make a sweet and tangy jelly! I brought some today for everyone to taste.$1
records.translation: Naging masagana ba ang ani mo ng Salmonberry?$0#$b#Sapat ang napitas ko para gumawa ng matamis at maasim na halaya! Nagdala ako ngayon ng ilan para matikman ng lahat.$1

records.source: Hey, you shouldn't be back here!$3#$e#Well, if you're sticking around... mind manning the booth for a while? I want to taste Linus' sweet and tangy jelly.#$e#I'm joking, I can't bear to be away from the register...$2
records.translation: Hoy, hindi ka dapat naririto sa likuran!$3#$e#Pero kung mananatili ka rito... maaari mo bang bantayan sandali ang puwesto? Gusto kong tikman ang matamis at maasim na halaya ni Linus.#$e#Nagbibiro lang ako, hindi ko kayang lumayo sa kaha...$2

records.source: I'd ask my husband to dance, but he doesn't really know how.$0
records.translation: Yayain ko sanang sumayaw ang asawa ko, pero hindi talaga siya marunong.$0

records.source: The key to dancing is to have confidence.$1
records.translation: Tiwala sa sarili ang susi sa pagsasayaw.$1

records.source: Flowers? More like bumblebee magnets. Hmph. Can't smell much anyway.$0
records.translation: Mga bulaklak? Mas bagay tawaging pang-akit sa mga bubuyog. Hmph. Hindi rin naman ako gaanong nakaaamoy.$0

records.source: I used to visit this spot when I was younger. It hasn't changed much over the years.$0
records.translation: Dati akong pumupunta sa lugar na ito noong bata pa ako. Hindi ito gaanong nagbago sa paglipas ng mga taon.$0

records.source: Good afternoon, @. The weather for today's festivities couldn't be more perfect.$0#$b#Come talk to me when you're ready to start the ceremony.$0
records.translation: Magandang hapon, @. Perpekto ang panahon para sa pagdiriwang natin ngayon.$0#$b#Kausapin mo ako kapag handa ka nang simulan ang seremonya.$0

records.source: *sigh* Everyone is partnered up... and here I am alone, once again...$2#$e#Ah well... I'll just drown my sorrows with some of that sweet and tangy jelly.
records.translation: *buntong-hininga* May kapareha ang lahat... at narito na naman akong mag-isa...$2#$e#Ah, ayos lang... Lulunurin ko na lang ang kalungkutan ko sa matamis at maasim na halayang iyon.

records.source: Vincent asked me to dance with him. Isn't that cute?$0
records.translation: Niyaya ako ni Vincent na sumayaw kasama niya. Hindi ba nakakatuwa iyon?$0

records.source: The red jelly wafting in the wind looks like it's dancing!$1#$e#Heh... Maybe that's just the wine speaking.$0
records.translation: Parang sumasayaw ang pulang halaya habang sumasabay sa hangin!$1#$e#Heh... Baka alak lang ang nagsasalita.$0

records.source: Oh, hey! This year I'm giving my sister competition for the flower queen title.$0#$b#I've been working on my choreography!$1
records.translation: Ah, kumusta! Ngayong taon, makikipagpaligsahan ako sa kapatid ko para sa titulo ng Reyna ng mga Bulaklak.$0#$b#Pinaghirapan ko ang koreograpiya ko!$1

records.source: One, two, three... one, two, three... Oh, hi. I'm a little busy.$0
records.translation: Isa, dalawa, tatlo... isa, dalawa, tatlo... Ah, kumusta. Medyo abala ako.$0

records.source: I have special earrings I only wear once a year for this event.$0#$e#They're little daffodils... see?$h
records.translation: May mga espesyal akong hikaw na isang beses ko lang isinusuot bawat taon para sa okasyong ito.$0#$e#Maliliit na narsiso ang mga ito... kita mo?$h

records.source: Do you ever wonder... why do we find flowers beautiful?#$e#If Jodi and I ever have a daughter, maybe we'll name her after a flower.$h
records.translation: Naisip mo na ba... bakit natin nakikitang magaganda ang mga bulaklak?#$e#Kung magkakaanak na babae kami ni Jodi, baka ipangalan namin siya sa isang bulaklak.$h

records.source: Hmm. Thought I saw something moving across the water.$0
records.translation: Hmm. Akala ko may nakita akong gumagalaw sa ibabaw ng tubig.$0

records.source: *sniff* I'd enjoy this get-together more if it wasn't for my allergies. I'll just have to suck it up!$0
records.translation: *singhot* Mas masisiyahan sana ako sa pagtitipong ito kung wala akong allergy. Kailangan ko na lang tiisin!$0

records.source: I really feel connected with nature this far away from town.$0
records.translation: Talagang malalim ang ugnayan ko sa kalikasan sa ganitong kalayo mula sa bayan.$0

records.source: I couldn't find any clean shirts so this one has to do.$0
records.translation: Wala akong mahanap na malinis na kamiseta, kaya ito na lang.$0

records.source: This open field is perfect grazing land for livestock, wouldn't you agree?$0#$e#Psst... I think Lewis is going to ask me to dance with him!$1
records.translation: Perpektong pastulan para sa mga alagang hayop ang malawak na parang na ito, hindi ba?$0#$e#Psst... Sa tingin ko, yayayain ako ni Lewis na sumayaw kasama niya!$1

records.source: To dance among a whimsical backdrop of flowers is an uplifting experience.$1
records.translation: Nakapagpapasigla ang sumayaw sa gitna ng mahiwagang tanawin ng mga bulaklak.$1

records.source: Have you tried the dandelion salad? I prepared it fresh right here!$0
records.translation: Natikman mo na ba ang salad ng dandelion? Sariwa ko itong inihanda rito mismo!$0

records.source: You say it's raining up above?#$e#Rain... It's almost mythical to us. Some of us live our entire lives without ever experiencing it.
records.translation: Sabi mo, umuulan sa itaas?#$e#Ulan... halos alamat lang iyon sa amin. Ang ilan sa amin ay nabubuhay nang hindi iyon nararanasan kailanman.

records.source: Hmm? How did you climb up here?$0
records.translation: Hmm? Paano ka nakaakyat dito?$0

records.source: If you spend some time pondering the hardships of life, it can put things into perspective.$0#$b#Suddenly, dancing in front of the whole town in an ill-fitting suit doesn't seem so bad!$h
records.translation: Kung maglalaan ka ng oras para pag-isipan ang mga paghihirap sa buhay, makikita mo ang mga bagay sa tamang pananaw.$0#$b#Biglang hindi na mukhang napakasama ang sumayaw sa harap ng buong bayan habang suot ang terno kong hindi kasya!$h

records.source: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong umuulan sa inyo. Iyon ba ang dahilan kung bakit ka pumunta rito?$h#$e#Sa totoo lang, medyo hinahanap-hanap ko rin ang ulan...$s

records.source: *giggle* Am I doing it right?$1
records.translation: *hagikgik* Tama ba ang ginagawa ko?$1

records.source: If there's a flower queen... there must be a flower king!$0
records.translation: Kung may Reyna ng mga Bulaklak... dapat may Hari rin ng mga Bulaklak!$0

records.source: Aye, these waters be teeming with big fish. Shame I didn't bring me rod!$0
records.translation: Aye, punô ng malalaking isda ang mga tubig na ito. Sayang at hindi ko dinala ang pamingwit ko!$0

records.source: You need a partner to participate in the dance? Does a bird count?$0
records.translation: Kailangan ng kapareha para makasali sa sayaw? Maaari bang ibon?$0
